tools.name: funding_events
tools.description: List funding events ordered by discovery time. Filter by round, amount range, company HQ country, industry group, or a specific company id. Costs one credit per returned record.

tools.name: acquisitions
tools.description: List acquisition and merger events ordered by discovery time. Filter by payment type, deal amount range, merger flag, or a company that is the acquirer or target. Costs one credit per returned record.

tools.name: exec_moves
tools.description: List executive appointment, promotion, departure, and transition events ordered by discovery time. Filter by company, person, role seniority, move type, or a time window. Costs one credit per returned record.

tools.name: companies
tools.description: Search and filter company records by keyword, exact domain, HQ country, industry group, employee-count bucket, or founded-year range. Costs one credit per returned record.

tools.name: investors
tools.description: Search and filter investor records by keyword, type, HQ country, or exact domain. Costs one credit per returned record.

tools.name: company_timeline
tools.description: Return one company's timeline: firmographics, investors, and a chronological list of funding rounds, acquisitions, and executive moves. Resolve the company by id, domain, name, or LinkedIn URL. Pick event kinds with include (default all). Costs one credit for the company plus one per pulled event; n

tools.name: list_watchlists
tools.description: List the workspace's account watchlists with member counts. Free.

tools.name: get_watchlist
tools.description: Return one watchlist with its resolved company members. Free.

tools.name: create_watchlist
tools.description: Create a named account watchlist. Free.

tools.name: add_to_watchlist
tools.description: Add companies (domain, name, LinkedIn URL, or id) to a watchlist. Returns a per-item result of added, already_present, or unresolved. Free.

tools.name: remove_from_watchlist
tools.description: Remove companies from a watchlist. Free.
